Show IT budget and run cost.
For Lakeshore Holdings, IT budget and run cost are visible across two owner entities with meaningful structural differences between them.
• Corporate Shared Services IT carries a $36.5M annual IT budget, split $23.6M run and $12.9M change — a 65/35 run-to-change ratio that signals moderate transformation investment at the holdco level, with $15.3M in YTD actuals tracking on pace.
• Northline IT is the larger entity at $42.6M annual budget, with $27.0M run and $15.6M change — a similar ratio but at greater scale, and $17.9M YTD actuals suggest spend is running slightly ahead of the Corporate pace proportionally.
• The combined portfolio IT budget across both owners is $79.1M, with $50.6M allocated to run cost — meaning roughly 64 cents of every IT dollar sustains current operations, leaving limited headroom for transformation unless opco budgets are rebalanced.
Caveat: Portfolio-level figures ($190.6M total, $154.1M opco local IT) reflect enterprise profile context and are not yet validated as Tower-grade budget business context. Full opco coverage beyond Northline is not confirmed in current business context.
Branch: **Tower** for budget allocation decisions and run-to-change tradeoff analysis | **Intelligence** for holdco vs. opco IT investment strategy | **Source** for vendor and contract cost drivers within run spend | **Moves** for sequencing any rebalancing effort.
